items.description: GMD semantic tokens, bilingual typography, hard depth, interaction states and project theme scopes. Light mode release.

.gmd-project-feature__title.font: 400 clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem)/1.12 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

.gmd-pattern-cover__content h2.font: 400 clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2.4rem)/1.12 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

.gmd-empty-state__body h2.font: 400 clamp(1.4rem, 2.3vw, 2rem)/1.2 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

[data-slot=skeleton].background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--muted), color-mix(in srgb, var(--gmd-nile-soft) 55%, var(--muted)), var(--muted))

export function DatePicker({ locale="en" }: { locale?: "en"|"ar" }) {
  const [date,setDate]=useState<Date|undefined>(new Date(2026,9,5))
  const ar=locale==="ar"
  return <Popover><PopoverTrigger asChild><Button variant="outline"><CalendarDays/>{date?.toLocaleDateString(ar?"ar-EG":"en-US")??(ar?"اختر تاريخًا":"Choose a date")}</Button></PopoverTrigger><PopoverContent align="start" aria-label={ar ? "اختيار التاريخ" : "Choose date"}><Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} locale={ar?arabic:undefined} dir={ar?"rtl":"ltr"}/></PopoverContent></Popover>
}
